_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor Repaired/Overhauled/Modified End Items Status Report
summary: This DID defines the report giving the government visibility of specified end items undergoing repair, overhaul, and/or modification at commercial contractor facilities.
use_relationship:
This report provides the government with visibility of specified end items undergoing repair, overhaul and / or modification at commercial contractor facilities.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-82263.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

children.title: The report content shall be as follows:
Contracted quantity for each National Stock Number (NSN) item.
Current quantity on hand for each NSN item.
Work in process quantity on each NSN item.
Quantity completed to date on each NSN item.
Unserviceable on hand quantity on each NSN item.
Identification and explanation of delays, accelerations, and problems.
The following is required for Repair/Overhaul of each end item*
Inducted Part Number (P/N)
children.content: Enter up to 32 characters, identifying the inducted part.

children.title: Component Serial Number
children.content: Enter up to 10 alphanumeric characters identifying the component being repaired.

children.title: Status
children.content: Indicate Repair Complete, Repair In-Work or Unable to Repair/Condemned. Amplifying Remarks.

children.title: The following is required when performing incorporation of a technical directive (TD) / modification*
Inducted Part Number (P/N)
children.content: Enter up to 32 characters, identifying the inducted part.

children.title: Component Serial Number
children.content: Enter up to 10 alphanumeric characters identifying the component being modified.

children.title: Produced P/N
children.content: Enter up to 32 characters, identifying the produced part number, when a TD resulted in a P/N change, if applicable.

children.title: Produced NSN
children.content: Enter 13 digits, when a TD P/N change resulted in new/different NSN. Date Inducted.

children.title: Status
children.content: Indicate Modification Complete, Modification In-Work or Unable to Modify/Condemned.
